om: Felen som SwingLab letar efter (BESLUT B6), och måtten som granskningen visar vid P-positionerna utan att vara fel (BESLUT B32). Läses av appen (SwingLabKit) och PC:n (tools/pc/katalog.py). Fälten står i docs/FORMAT.md, bedömningen i docs/METOD.md M27. En gräns är ej kontrollerad (kontrollerad: false) tills källan lästs i original (BESLUT B10).

fel.namn: Sway: the pelvis slides away from the target in the backswing
fel.ovning: Stick in the ground outside the trail hip. Swing to the top and stop: the hip turns, the stick stays put. Then feet together, 3/4 swings.
fel.notering: Låg handicap nära 0 (Sportsbox), tour ≈ +10 cm mot målet (GolfTEC). Gränsen är ett antagande byggt på de två (research 1 §1.1).
fel.vad: How far the hip center moves along the target line from address to the top.
fel.varfor: Sliding away from the target in the backswing makes it hard to get back to the ball (sway).

fel.ovning: Swing to a metronome or a Tour Tempo beat: three counts up, one down.
fel.tanke: The club meets the ball on the third beat.
fel.notering: Låg prioritet: tempot har inget belagt samband med utfallet (research 1 §1.9). Utanför grönt är gult, aldrig rött.
fel.vad: Backswing time divided by downswing time, from the start, the top and the impact click.
fel.varfor: A steady ratio is a sign of a repeatable rhythm; it has no proven link to the result.

fel.namn: Early extension: the pelvis moves toward the ball
fel.ovning: Glutes against a chair behind you at address. Slow swings that keep contact through impact while the pelvis rotates.
fel.tanke: The chair stays in contact all the way.
fel.notering: Egen baslinje tills tecknet och TPI-exemplet (> 3 tum mot bollen) är kontrollerade (research 1 §1.6).
fel.vad: How far the hips move toward the ball from address to impact.
fel.varfor: Moving toward the ball stands you up and pushes the hands out (early extension).

fel.namn: Loss of posture: the chest rises
fel.ovning: Same as early extension: the chair behind your glutes, and your head below a line on the wall in front of you.
fel.tanke: The ball sees the top of your cap all the way.
fel.notering: Felet i 2D är lika stort som förlusten, därför egen trend (research 1 §1.5).
fel.vad: How much the forward bend of the hip-to-shoulder line drops from address to impact.
fel.varfor: Standing up through impact moves the low point and the strike (loss of posture).

fel.namn: Too little hip shift from the top
fel.ovning: The step drill: feet together at address, step toward the target with the lead foot as the backswing changes direction. Ten reps with a short iron, no ball.
fel.notering: Sway bakåt och för lite förskjutning framåt är samma tema, bäckenets väg (PLAN S1).
fel.vad: How far the hip center moves toward the target from the top to impact.
fel.varfor: Too little shift leaves the weight back and the low point behind the ball.

fel.ovning: Feet together, 3/4 swings: the slide that feeds the fault disappears.
fel.tanke: The belt buckle beats the cap to the target.
fel.notering: Sportsbox definition och tecken är okända; vårt mått är bäckenets sway minus bröstets (M19). Ingen tour-gräns (research 1 §1.3).
fel.vad: Hip sway minus chest sway at impact, both from address.
fel.varfor: Hips ahead of the chest at impact go with a good shift and side bend (sway gap).

fel.ovning: Set up with the side bend that impact requires.
fel.tanke: The trail shoulder below the lead shoulder.
fel.notering: Avstängd: definitionen granskas i S0 och får ingen tour-gräns (METOD M17).
fel.vad: The angle of the shoulder line to level at impact, face on.
fel.varfor: The trail shoulder below the lead goes with side bend at impact; the measure is under review.

fel.namn: Reverse spine: the upper body leans toward the target at the top
fel.ovning: Feet together (removes the slide that feeds the fault), and TPI’s Reach Over the Fence.
fel.tanke: The cap stays behind the ball at the top.
fel.notering: Negativ sidböjning i toppen = mot målet = reverse spine (METOD M14).
fel.vad: The lean of the hip-to-shoulder line from vertical at the top, face on.
fel.varfor: Leaning toward the target at the top is reverse spine.

fel.namn: Chicken wing: the lead elbow folds after impact
fel.ovning: Half swings toward the 4:30 path, with the lead wrist flexed (motorcycle) through impact.
fel.tanke: The clubhead passes the hands after the ball.
fel.notering: Inga tal vid träff i källorna; egen baslinje (research 1 §1.11).
fel.vad: Lead elbow bend just after impact, shoulder to elbow to wrist.
fel.varfor: A lead elbow that folds after impact is the chicken wing.

fel.namn: Flying elbow: the trail elbow points out at the top
fel.ovning: No swing drill found. Test 90/90 (trail shoulder external rotation) first: if it is limited, it is mobility.
fel.tanke: A towel under the trail arm stays in place to the top.
fel.vad: Trail upper arm angle from vertical at the top, shoulder to elbow, down the line.
fel.varfor: A trail elbow pointing out at the top is the flying elbow.

fel.namn: Over the top: the hands move out in the downswing
fel.ovning: A headcover outside and slightly behind the ball. If you hit it, the club came from outside.
fel.notering: Ingen gräns i cm hittad (research 1 §1.11). Handens bana, inte klubbans, tills S7.
fel.vad: How far outside the backswing path the hands come down, at three heights.
fel.varfor: Hands moving out toward the ball in the downswing is over the top.

fel.namn: Bent lead arm at the top
fel.ovning: Swing to the top and stop against a wall behind you: the clubhead reaches the wall with a straight arm, not a bent one.
fel.tanke: The clubhead far from your head at the top.
fel.notering: För en vänsterspelare är det högerarmen (främre). GolfTEC: 76° mot 10° är ett elevexempel, ingen norm.
fel.vad: Lead elbow bend at the top, shoulder to elbow to wrist.
fel.varfor: A bent lead arm at the top shortens the swing arc.

matt.vad: The forward bend of the hip-to-shoulder line from vertical at address.
matt.varfor: The spine angle at address is what loss of posture is measured from.

matt.vad: Trail knee bend at address, hip to knee to ankle.
matt.varfor: Knee flex sets the posture the body turns around.

matt.vad: Ankle width divided by shoulder width at address.
matt.varfor: Stance width sets the balance and how freely the hips turn.

matt.vad: The angle of the shoulder line to level at address, face on.
matt.varfor: The trail shoulder lower at address sets up the side bend at impact.

matt.vad: The angle of the hip line to level at address, face on.
matt.varfor: Shows how the hips are set before the swing.

matt.vad: How far the hip center moves along the target line from address to P3.
matt.varfor: Shows a slide away from the target early in the backswing (sway).

matt.vad: Lead elbow bend at P3, shoulder to elbow to wrist.
matt.varfor: Shows whether the lead arm bends early in the backswing (bent lead arm).

matt.vad: How far the hip center moves toward the target from the top to P5.
matt.varfor: Shows the hip shift so far in the downswing (too little hip shift).

matt.vad: How far the hands move along the target line from address to impact.
matt.varfor: Hands ahead at impact go with shaft lean and a ball-first strike.

matt.vad: The nose minus the hip center along the target line in the finish.
matt.varfor: The head over the hips shows a balanced finish.

matt.vad: The mean of the torso and trail thigh lean from vertical; an estimate, not the pelvic tilt.
matt.varfor: Shows how the hip hinge holds; it does not show early extension.

matt.vad: Lead knee bend, hip to knee to ankle, down the line.
matt.varfor: The lead knee straightening toward impact shows how the lead leg posts.

matt.vad: The mean of the torso and trail thigh lean from vertical; an estimate, not the pelvic tilt.
matt.varfor: Shows how the hip hinge holds; it does not show early extension.

matt.vad: Lead knee bend, hip to knee to ankle, down the line.
matt.varfor: The lead knee straightening toward impact shows how the lead leg posts.

matt.vad: How far the shoulder center moves up or down from address.
matt.varfor: The chest rising at impact goes with loss of posture.

matt.vad: How far the hands move up or down from address.
matt.varfor: Shows how high the hands go at the top and where they return at impact.

matt.vad: How far the hands move toward or away from the ball from address to the top.
matt.varfor: Shows how deep the hands go behind you at the top.
matt.tecken: + toward ball · − in toward the body

matt.vad: The angle between the lead arm, shoulder to wrist, and the shoulder line at the top.
matt.varfor: Shows whether the lead arm swings above or below the shoulder turn.

matt.vad: The mean of the torso and trail thigh lean from vertical; an estimate, not the pelvic tilt.
matt.varfor: Shows how the hip hinge holds; it does not show early extension.

matt.vad: Lead knee bend, hip to knee to ankle, down the line.
matt.varfor: The lead knee straightening toward impact shows how the lead leg posts.

matt.vad: How far the shoulder center moves up or down from address.
matt.varfor: The chest rising at impact goes with loss of posture.

matt.vad: How far the hands move up or down from address.
matt.varfor: Shows how high the hands go at the top and where they return at impact.

matt.vad: Time from impact until hand speed falls under 10 % of its peak after impact.
matt.varfor: Shows how long the swing keeps moving into the finish.

matt.vad: How far the lead knee moves along the target line from address.
matt.varfor: The knees show how the lower body shifts.

matt.vad: How far the trail knee moves along the target line from address.
matt.varfor: A trail knee sliding away from the target goes with a sway.

matt.vad: How far the shoulder center moves up or down from address.
matt.varfor: The chest rising at impact goes with loss of posture.

matt.vad: How far the hands move up or down from address.
matt.varfor: Shows how high the hands go at the top and where they return at impact.

matt.vad: The peak turning speed of the lead arm, shoulder to wrist, in the downswing, in the picture.
matt.varfor: Shows how fast the lead arm swings down; untested on the phone.

matt.vad: How far the lead knee moves along the target line from address.
matt.varfor: The knees show how the lower body shifts.

matt.vad: How far the trail knee moves along the target line from address.
matt.varfor: A trail knee sliding away from the target goes with a sway.

matt.vad: How far the shoulder center moves up or down from address.
matt.varfor: The chest rising at impact goes with loss of posture.

matt.vad: How far the hands move up or down from address.
matt.varfor: Shows how high the hands go at the top and where they return at impact.

matt.vad: The peak speed of the hands from the top to impact, in the picture.
matt.varfor: Hand speed drives club speed; face on it is a lower bound; untested on the phone.

matt.vad: How long before impact the hands reach their peak speed.
matt.varfor: A peak long before impact means the hands slow into the ball; untested on the phone.

matt.vad: Time from impact until hand speed falls under 10 % of its peak after impact.
matt.varfor: Shows how long the swing keeps moving into the finish.
